title: American Growth Insurance, which aims to acquire struggling independent insurance firms and transform them using AI, raised almost $70M (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: American Growth Insurance, which aims to acquire struggling independent insurance firms and transform them using AI, raised almost $70M — A startup called American Growth Insurance said today it has raised almost $70 million in committed equity capital to transform the insurance industry.
